symptom: Public vacation business pages intermittently returned HTTP 500 during a bounded three-request catalog sweep.
expected_behavior: Every accepted public catalog place returns a stable HTTP 200 page with an H1 under bounded read concurrency.
environment: Public VII release 567 at https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-10-21, AWS Aurora database mode primary, three concurrent read-only requests.

steps: Enumerate all four live lookup catalogs.
Request each of the 918 accepted detail URLs with concurrency three.
Record response status and H1 without retries.
reproduction.evidence: project_knowledge/release_evidence/vii-owned-validation-release-20261021/catalog/catalog-integrity.json recorded 90 transient HTTP 500 vacation pages; later direct requests to the same IDs returned 200.

observations.observation: The four runtime lookup and detail catalogs reconciled at 573 vacations, 133 events, 53 rooms and 159 spas.
observations.evidence: catalog-integrity.json world counts; the initial spa mismatch was an audit ID-normalization defect and has been corrected.

observations.observation: Ninety vacation pages failed during the bounded concurrent sweep, then representative failed IDs 28, 65 and 2662 returned 200 immediately afterward.
observations.evidence: catalog-integrity.json plus direct post-sweep HTTP checks.

observations.observation: The production environment is configured with VII_AWS_DB_MODE=primary and an AWS database endpoint.
observations.evidence: Authenticated Sites settings page; secret values were not read or stored.

hypotheses.mechanism: A transient AWS database bridge read failure propagates through uncaught catalog SELECT operations and aborts server rendering.
hypotheses.prediction: Failures cluster under concurrent cold reads, the same entity later succeeds, and one bounded retry at the database adapter read boundary prevents the render failure without retrying writes.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run an exhaustive no-retry public sweep, compare failed entity retests, then unit-test one 503 followed by success at the AWS adapter.
hypotheses.result: Ninety 500s occurred under concurrency three; representative failed entities later returned 200; adapter test passed with exactly two SELECT attempts and one write attempt.

hypotheses.mechanism: The failing vacation records contain malformed or missing catalog data.
hypotheses.prediction: The same IDs fail consistently and lookup/detail reconciliation reports missing records.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare all lookup IDs to full catalog entries and retest failed IDs individually.
hypotheses.result: Vacation lookup and detail counts matched 573 with no missing or orphan records, and failed IDs later returned 200.

hypotheses.mechanism: The BizOnline live-detail request throws and escapes the page fallback.
hypotheses.prediction: Failures persist per supplier or track the external detail endpoint.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect liveSupplierPlaceDetail error handling and retest affected suppliers.
hypotheses.result: The live-detail function catches upstream errors and returns accepted fallback data; affected suppliers later rendered normally.

fix.change: Retry exactly once after 125 milliseconds only for non-transactional SQL SELECT calls when the AWS bridge fetch fails, returns 429, or returns 5xx. Never retry run operations, writes or transactional batches.
fix.evidence: tests/aws-database-adapter.test.mjs proves one transient SELECT retry succeeds, no third request is sent, and an uncertain UPDATE remains single-attempt. Public release 570 then passed 917 of 917 accepted entity pages and 859 of 859 unique primary-image checks with zero failures.

affected_family: All public routes reading accepted supplier catalogs through the AWS adapter
Read-only admin and reporting queries using SELECT

regression_checks.check: AWS adapter read, write, raw and batch semantics
Removed supplier IDs are not resurrected
Accepted detail and review snapshot behavior

authorization_boundary: Code repair, read-only production verification and publication are authorized; writes, booking, payments and messages are excluded.
